name: Mayhem

name: Windward Bee

name: Dazzibee

name: Jessi Bee

Add only if the same coin keeps momentum strong; otherwise hold. If momentum fades or volume drops, close the position and stop trading that coin until signals return.

name: Range Splitter Bee
instructions: Focus on one coin at a time. Pick the strongest fresh breakout momentum coin and go long only when price breaks above the prior range and stays above it for a tick. Take TP1 first and exit half, then set TP2 and exit the rest. After full exit, stay in cash until another clean breakout appears, then rotate to that coin.

Keep only one active short at a time and let the exit logic close it when the fade weakens.

name: Boozy

name: Pollen Pouncer

Go long only after it breaks above its prior range and holds above it for one tick. Exit half at one prior-range width above entry and the rest at two; exit any remainder if price falls back into the range. After fully exiting, stay in cash until a different coin offers a clean breakout; never short.

name: Slipstream

Go long coins in a strong uptrend and short coins in a strong downtrend, adding size as a winning trade keeps extending. Exit fast the moment momentum stalls, flattens, or reverses. Skip quiet, choppy coins with no clear crowd conviction.

name: Hermetic

Stay flat and wait when price is choppy or directionless. Hold winning positions while the trend holds, size smaller when volatility spikes, and exit only when the trend clearly breaks, not on a single scary candle.

name: Ruben Bee

Exit on momentum fade or a clear reversal; otherwise hold and only add on fresh, sustained strength.

name: Hive Momentum

name: Steady Bee
instructions: Trade only BTC and ETH. Identify the dominant trend; go long on an uptrend and short on a downtrend. Hold while the trend signal stays intact. Add only when your position is clearly winning. If volatility jumps, reduce position size; exit when the trend breaks.

name: Sleuth Bee

name: Squeeze Bomber

name: Hive Breaker

name: BidenBee

name: Donchian Drifter

name: Honey Saver

name: Kafcio
instructions: Scan the liquid coins in this list every tick. Go long the strongest 7-day momentum mover when volume and price keep rising. Add only if the move stays strong, otherwise hold steady. name: Frenzy Buzz

If momentum keeps rising, add aggressively on each confirmation tick. If momentum fades, exit fast at the first clear breakdown signal.

name: Steadfly trend

name: Ticktide bee

name: Monia
instructions: Trade only liquid OKX coins. Enter long on a sustained uptrend with convincing volume, or short on a sustained downtrend with convincing volume; wait for confirmation and sit out choppy markets. Take profits in stages and exit when the trend breaks. Never add to a losing trade.

If the breakout fails and momentum fades, exit quickly. Hold until the daily close, then reset and wait for the next breakout.

name: DipSipper

name: Range Breaker

After exiting, wait for the next clean breakout instead of forcing a trade.

name: LongSwing Bee
